subject: Post-call recap: audit logs & PII handling follow-ups
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@fincobank.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: audit logs & PII handling follow-ups

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap of the key items we discussed and next steps from Redwood: 

- Objective: confirm audit log capabilities to support your compliance review (who accessed what/when, export formats, retention controls, PII flags).
- Action items for Redwood: sample export of audit logs, schema docs, retention policy options, and mapping of PII markers.
- Action items for FinCo: confirm whether you need access to raw logs vs. filtered exports, and provide a preferred SFTP/secure link for sharing evidence if needed.

What we can deliver this week:
- Sample CSV export showing the fields we capture (user_id, action, resource, timestamp, ip, request_id, object_type, pii_flag).
- Short schema PDF explaining each column and the default retention windows.
- Notes on how to configure longer retention or offload to your storage (S3/GCS) for audit purposes.

Questions from the call that we flagged for follow-up:
1) Retention: default platform retention is 90 days for detailed request logs; aggregated metrics can be retained longer. We can configure longer retention under Dedicated / Private deployments — needs contract/ops coordination.
2) PII: we tag events with a pii_flag when the request references known PII-containing objects (customer_name, ssn, email). The logs do not store full model input/output by default unless you enable request recording.
3) Access controls: logs are surfaced in the Console for admin roles; exports are available to account admins and can be programmatically pulled via our secure export API.

Next steps / proposed timeline:
- Today: I’ll send a sample CSV + schema PDF (attached) and a short description of export formats.
- EOD tomorrow: we can prepare a scoped export from a redacted environment if you want a small, representative dataset for your reviewers.

If you can confirm the SFTP / secure upload target or whether you prefer a secure Drive link, I’ll route the artifacts accordingly.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@fincobank.com>, FinCo Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: audit logs & PII handling follow-ups

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side before we dig into the attachments: 

- For the sample export, please ensure any PII fields are redacted but that the pii_flag column remains populated so our reviewers can test detection.
- Can you confirm whether the logs include a request_id that can be correlated back to stored artifacts (if request recording is enabled)? We need to be able to tie an "access" event to the related object when doing an audit.
- Retention: our minimum requirement for detailed request logs is 12 months for this line of business. If 90 days is the default, please outline options and estimated costs for extending retention to 12 months (either by configuration or by exporting to our S3).
- Export formats: CSV is fine, but could you also provide JSONLines example for large-scale exports?

Also: please provide the following evidence items if possible (even redacted/sample versions):
1) One example export (redacted) covering 24 hours of activity with pii_flag present.
2) The audit-log schema PDF describing each field and data types.
3) A short note on RBAC — which internal roles have Console/export rights by default and how we can restrict those.

We can accept a secure Drive link from your side. I’ll loop in procurement/security if we need an SFTP.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
InfoSec Lead, FinCo Bank
a.gomez@fincobank.com | +1 (212) 555-0147
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <a.gomez@fincobank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: audit logs & PII handling follow-ups

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached are the two artifacts I mentioned: redwood-audit-log-sample.csv (24-hour redacted sample) and redwood-audit-log-schema.pdf. Quick answers inline below and summary of next operational steps.

- Redaction: the sample CSV has user identifiers hashed and PII fields redacted; pii_flag is preserved as true/false.
- request_id: yes — audit logs include a persistent request_id that can be used to locate full recordings if request recording is enabled for the account. We include request_id and object_id/object_type in the export.
- Retention: default detailed request logs = 90 days on Hosted. Options to meet 12 months:
   * Dedicated/Private deployment: configurable retention up to multi-year via disk or offload to customer-managed S3 (we can set retention policy per dataset).
   * Export to customer S3: we can schedule daily exports in JSONLines or CSV and deposit to a supplied S3 bucket. Estimated incremental cost for 12-month offload for your projected volume: ~ $X/month — I’ll have Finance follow up with a concrete estimate; for now we can scope.
- Export formats: we support CSV and JSONLines (newline-delimited JSON). The sample includes CSV; I attached a one-line JSONLines example inside the schema PDF as well.
- RBAC: by default, Console export and Logs access are granted to Account Admins and Security Admins. For additional tightness we can: remove Console export rights for engineers, enable export approval workflow, or send exports only to an integration user with restricted keys.

Next operational steps:
1) I uploaded the artifacts to a secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/redwood/compliance-pack/finco (link above).
2) If you confirm you want a scheduled daily export to your S3, please share an IAM role or S3 presigned location and we’ll run an initial 7-day pilot export for validation.
3) Ben (cc’d) will coordinate a cost estimate and ops plan for 12-month retention or Dedicated options.

Let us know if you want a short follow-up call this week with Security + Engineering to walk through the sample.

Thanks —

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
